why.terrace: Organised supporter groups and big home choreographies; known as one of Turkey's loudest crowds; slogan 'Bize her yer Trabzon'.
why.city: Trabzon's only major club and regional identity; first Anatolian club to break the Istanbul clubs' hold on the title.
why.voice: Members' association: congress elects the president (Ertugrul Dogan, re-elected unopposed Nov 2024); the listed football company is controlled by the association.
why.conscience: Sanctioned violence: fans invaded the pitch and attacked Fenerbahce players in March 2024 (TFF closed-doors ban, reduced to four matches on appeal); 2016 assistant-referee attack. No racism case found.
why.ground: Senol Gunes Sports Complex (Papara Park), 40,980, opened 2016 on the coast outside the centre; loud, well filled for big matches.
why.contender: Super Lig champions 2021-22 (7 titles), Turkish Cup 2025-26 (10 total); 3rd in 2023-24 and 2025-26.
why.rituals: 'Bize her yer Trabzon' chant and claret-and-blue choreographies; known in Turkey, not much beyond.
why.stewardship: Member club run by elected president Ertugrul Dogan; heavy debt and a 2019-20 UEFA FFP European ban.
why.women: Operates a women's team; profile low (estimate).
why.intensity: No clear identity: coaches rotate (Avci, Bjelica, Gunes, now Thomas Reis); estimate.
